items.note: Vāstu is the planned site, square as a rule, with the full name Vāstupuruṣamāṇḍala.
The Vāstupuruṣamaṇḍala is the plan of all Hindu architectural form; site-plan, ground-plan and sections are regulated by its norm.
Mayamata prescribes a square Vāstu for gods and Brāhmaṇas; the square is the fundamental form of Indian architecture.
